Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to extract the director's death date from the Wikipedia page visible in the search results for "La Escondida 1956 Roberto Gavaldón director". While the page clearly displayed the director's name and film details, the agent did not notice or extract the specific death date information (which is usually found in the infobox or introductory text of the director's Wikipedia page) and instead continued to loop with the same instruction to search for the death date without actually performing a new search or opening the specific director's profile page to retrieve the data. This failure to gather the critical piece of information (Gavaldón's death date) prevented the task from being completed correctly.
